upperClean.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: precisely registered clean background atlas for an illustrated pixel-art animation.
Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: a 2x2 atlas of FOUR equal square panels. Keep its exact 2x2 layout, geometry, camera, cropping and texture. Return a square atlas with all features registered to their original normalized coordinates.
Change ONLY these hanging objects: TOP LEFT panel remove the two large white folded zigzag paper streamers from the sacred tree rope; TOP RIGHT panel remove the three large white folded paper streamers from the tree rope; BOTTOM LEFT panel remove the two white paper streamers and the tiny golden hanging bell at the center of the foreground red torii's rope. BOTTOM RIGHT panel stays completely unchanged.
For each removed object reconstruct only the few pixels of tree bark, moss, forest or steps directly behind it. KEEP ALL braided sacred ropes unchanged, including their position, shape, lighting and attachment points. Preserve all architecture, plants and tiny distant background objects. No new objects, no relighting, no redesign, no blur or smoothing, no border or lettering. Match the reference's fine textured illustrated pixel art. These clean patches will sit under the original moving objects, so registration and exact unchanged surroundings are essential.

canopy.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: two transparent leafy-bough sprites for the existing daytime pixel-art shrine animation.
Image 1 is STYLE AND COLOR REFERENCE ONLY. Match its fine textured illustrated pixel art: forest-green, moss-green and muted yellow-green leaves, soft gold daylight on the tips, brown fine woody branches. No red foliage in these two sprites.
Create a landscape transparent RGBA sprite sheet with TWO EQUAL columns and generous transparent gutters. Each column contains ONE whole connected leafy bough, with its root at lower LEFT and its leaves spreading upward/right. First bough narrow, airy and upward-reaching. Second bough differently shaped, gently arching right with distinct small clusters. Modest oak-like oval/lobed leaves fitting the canopy in the reference, not large tropical leaves. Separate clusters and twigs with transparent gaps. Keep every leaf attached to thin secondary twigs, branch tips delicate. These will be rendered at small scale in the upper corners, so use clear grouped pixel shapes and restrained detail matching the reference, no photographic veins, no smooth vector edges, no chunky voxel style.
No tree trunks, no ground, architecture, sky, scenery, characters, cast shadows, text or labels. True fully transparent background with clean alpha, no haze or halo. Both entire boughs must fit their own equal column without touching the other column. No clipping. Landscape 2:1 canvas.
